seo.title: Host an event at ODDspace — gallery and auditorium in Vallila
seo.description: ODDspace as a venue: a gallery and event floor, an auditorium and a studio in Vallila, Helsinki. Exhibitions, launches, workshops, talks, screenings, shoots and performances. Published rates from €300 for creative organisations, €450 for promoters and €750 for companies.

whatItIs.headline: A gallery floor, an auditorium, and flexible space for events.
whatItIs.body: ODDspace is a working creative space in Vallila with two bookable event rooms in it — a gallery and event floor, and an auditorium with tiered seating. Exhibitions, launches, workshops, talks, screenings, shoots, gatherings, performances and organisational events have all happened here. It does not feel like a hotel conference room — which is exactly why many choose it.

spacesIntro.headline: Two bookable rooms, plus the studio.

spaces.name: Event & gallery floor
spaces.body: The raised, curved main floor — the room most events happen in. Exhibitions, launches, workshops, shoots, receptions and performances.
bullets: Ticketed nights, company days and community events

spaces.name: Auditorium
spaces.body: Tiered seating for talks, panels, screenings, presentations and smaller events — people facing one direction, without having to build a stage.
bullets: Screen, sound and mics in the room

spaces.name: ODDstudio
spaces.body: The recording and production room, run with TUNEMENT. Booked separately from the event rooms — useful alongside an event for recording, podcasts or live sessions.
bullets: Genelec monitoring and a mic locker
From €20 / hour for members, from €30 / hour without

pricing.headline: The price works the way your event does.
pricing.body: Three ways to book, because a collective selling €15 tickets and a company throwing a launch are not the same customer. Find the one that describes you and the number is already on this page — no enquiry needed to know what it costs.

rateGroups.label: Creative organisations
rateGroups.intro: Associations, collectives, artists and curators. Selling tickets? Take the Door Deal. Free entry? Take the Community Rate.

rates.name: Door Deal — a ticketed night
rates.note: A gallery evening with house PA, lights, a technician and a host. The first €400 of ticket sales covers the room; above that you keep 70%, and 80% past €1,000. €100 deposit, credited back. We answer in three days.

rates.name: Community Rate — free or non-commercial
rates.note: Gallery or auditorium, up to 8 hours, with house PA, mics and an ODD host. Openings, screenings, talks and workshops. Technician +€200.

rateGroups.label: Promoters
rateGroups.intro: Gigs, club nights and recurring series. A flat fee, and every ticket is yours.

rates.name: Weeknight, Sunday–Thursday
rates.note: The gallery floor from 15:00 load-in, house PA and lights, an ODD host on site for keys, doors and alarms. Technician +€200.

rates.name: Weekend, Friday–Saturday
rates.note: Everything in the weeknight, on the two nights people actually go out. Technician +€200.

rates.name: Season — four nights or more
rates.note: Book a run and every night in it is 15% off.

rateGroups.label: Companies
rateGroups.intro: Launches, workshops, team and client events. One price, everything handled.

rates.name: Half day, up to 5 hours
rates.note: Gallery or auditorium with screen, sound and mics, an ODD host, setup and cleaning. Extra hour €150.

rates.name: Full day or evening, up to 10 hours
rates.note: Everything in the half day, plus event PA, lighting and a technician on site. Friday–Saturday evening €1,800. Extra hour €150.

rates.name: Produced by ODD
rates.note: Concept, programme, artists and performers — the team behind ODDfest runs the night. Quoted per event.

ratesNote: All prices are plus VAT. Company bookings are invoiced 50% on booking and the rest after the event; a bar runs through a licensed caterer or your own permit. ODDspace members book the rooms at member rates — €200 for a full day in the gallery, €100 for a half day in the auditorium. ODDstudio is €20 an hour for members, or €100 a month for full access; non-member studio rates are on the ODDstudio page.

whatWeCanDo.headline: Need more than a venue?
whatWeCanDo.body: The team behind ODDspace also develops and produces events, programmes and creative projects. If you need help with the concept, programme, production or bringing the right people together, tell us in your enquiry. We can build a wider collaboration around the event — or simply give you the room and let you run with it.

howItWorks.title: Tell us the date and the idea
howItWorks.body: What you're planning, the date or dates, roughly how many people, and what you need the room to do.

howItWorks.title: We come back with availability and a price
howItWorks.body: Whether the date is free, which room fits, what the space can and cannot do for that plan, and what it costs.

howItWorks.title: We confirm it in writing
howItWorks.body: Times, access, setup and what's included, agreed before anything is booked in.

askUs.headline: Things we answer per event, not on a page.
askUs.body: Tell us what you're planning and when. We'll confirm the relevant capacities, technical setup, access, availability and anything else you need to know for your event.

faq.question: Do I need to be a member to book?
faq.answer: No. Renting the gallery or the auditorium doesn't require a membership — everyone books from the rates on this page. Members simply pay member rates instead: €200 for a full day in the gallery, €100 for a half day in the auditorium.

faq.question: What does it cost?
faq.answer: It depends on who you are, not on how hard you negotiate. Creative organisations: €300 for a free or non-commercial event, or €0 upfront on a ticketed night where we take the first €400 at the door. Promoters: €450 on a weeknight, €650 at the weekend, and you keep every ticket. Companies: €750 for a half day, €1,200 for a full day or evening, €1,800 on a Friday or Saturday night, from €4,000 if you want us to produce the whole thing. All plus VAT. Members book at member rates.

faq.question: How many people fit?
faq.answer: It depends on the room and the layout, and we would rather give you a real number for your format than a flattering one on a webpage. Tell us the date and the kind of event and we'll tell you what the room actually takes.

faq.question: What AV and technical equipment is there?
faq.answer: Ask us with your plan. What's in the building, what we can bring in and what you should bring yourself depends on what you're doing — and we are still documenting the full inventory properly rather than listing it approximately.

faq.question: Is the space accessible?
faq.answer: We do not have verified accessibility information for the building to publish yet — step-free access, lifts, accessible toilets and door widths are still being documented, and we would rather say that than reassure you about something we have not measured. If accessibility matters for your event, email hello@oddfest.co and we will tell you exactly what the space can and cannot do today.

faq.question: Can I bring my own caterer, DJ or production team?
faq.answer: Usually yes — tell us who and what in the enquiry so we can check it against the building's own rules and confirm it with you before you book anyone.

faq.question: Can ODD help produce the event, not just rent the room?
faq.answer: Yes. We produce our own events here every week. Say what you have in mind and we'll tell you what we could take on and what that would cost.

faq.question: Can we record the event?
faq.answer: ODDstudio is in the same building and is booked separately — from €20 / hour for members and from €30 / hour without. Say so in your enquiry and we'll line the two bookings up.

faq.question: How far ahead should I ask?
faq.answer: As early as you can — the space is in daily use and popular dates go first. If your date is soon, ask anyway; sometimes it works.

finalCta.headline: Is your date free?
finalCta.body: Tell us the date, roughly how many people, and what you're planning. You'll get availability, a price and a straight answer about what the space can do.
